input.brief_text: Necesitamos dos archivos para Acme: PDF y JSON. Ambos deben contener la cadena exacta "Ready to ship". Plazo: 15 de noviembre. Presupuesto: 500 EUR. Se supone que los datos de origen ya se han proporcionado. Escribe este análisis en inglés.
input.deliverable_text: Solo se ha entregado el PDF para Acme con la cadena "Ready to ship". No se ha entregado el JSON. Se han respetado el plazo y el presupuesto.

criteria: Every authored canonical field follows the expected analysis language, including summaries and evidence explanations.

document.summary: The work does not meet expectations because the required JSON file was not delivered. The first priority is to deliver the missing JSON file containing the exact string "Ready to ship".

sections.title: Verdict
sections.content: The work does not meet expectations. Scope coverage is not satisfied: the brief requires both PDF and JSON files for Acme, but the delivery states that only the PDF was delivered and the JSON was not. Requirement fit is not satisfied: the delivered PDF contains the exact string "Ready to ship", and the delivery reports that the deadline and budget were respected, but the required JSON containing the same string was not delivered. Completeness is not satisfied: of the two required files, only the PDF is reported as delivered, and the JSON is explicitly missing. Clarity is satisfied: the delivery plainly identifies the PDF as delivered, confirms its required string, explicitly states that the JSON was not delivered, and reports compliance with the deadline and budget. The verdict is judged on these four general review criteria, not item by item on the acceptance criteria listed below.
